# Ignored and generated worktree inventory

**Captured:** 2026-11-20 (Asia/Dhaka)
**Source baseline:** `f04b7261ef9ba2dba2c38fd987f760e80583f2d2`
**Scope:** every path returned by `git ls-files -oi --exclude-standard` at capture; tracked files are inventoried separately in [`FILE-INVENTORY.md`](FILE-INVENTORY.md). This snapshot has 9879 paths. Each regular-file row records exact byte size and SHA-256; symlinks record/hash their link text without following it. Content hashing is not semantic review. No files were deleted or modified by inventory generation.

The largest ignored group is `node_modules` (9,626 files, installed third-party dependencies; lockfile/build provenance and license coverage require separate semantic review). `dist/` has 150 generated site outputs, `.astro/` has 3 cache entries, and the remainder includes Python bytecode, experiment/test caches, and `distro-test-retest.log`. The log content was not opened; only metadata and digest were collected to avoid disclosing potentially private command output.

- `.astro`: 3
- `dist`: 150
- `distro-test-retest.log`: 1
- `experiments`: 35
- `lib`: 8
- `node_modules`: 9626
- `tests`: 26
